pages.title: Words That Work
pages.text: Complete one successful spell cast from a Scroll or Spell Book.

pages.title: Words That Work
pages.text: Move from reading to casting; simple supplies let you continue experimenting.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Choose an affordable spell and its valid target. Credit is given after the native cast completes; a right-click with insufficient mana or an interrupted cast does not count.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: A scroll can cast directly: it consumes the scroll once under native costs/cooldowns distinct from a book.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Defaults are R for wheel, V for selected cast and Left Alt+scroll to cycle; check remaps. Fifteen quick-cast slots begin unbound.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Books spend mana and respect cooldowns; scrolls consume themselves through another path, and sword mana cost depends on server configuration.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: The server resolves spells from the actual equipped container; an empty selection request does not create a spell.
